description: Terminal-verifier decorrelation row trained against probe_iid: the IID probe v2 (terminal_prerl_v2, with reasoning, follow-up readout; docs/inkling_probes_amendment_1.md), a frozen probe on the full-precision Inkling-Small reader (thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small@8cc5877b44d343f88b92086aa1fb72897950f06a), scored live by experiments/inkling_probe_server.py at server_url (http://127.0.0.1:8178, reached from the RL machine through an SSH tunnel; one server serves both v2 probes). Reward = submission verdict - penalty_coef x the probe's score in the reward as the monitor defines it (monitors/inkling_probe_monitor.py). Held out, scored at every eval and never in the gradient: the same four local Qwen judges as the terminal_verifier_q{3,35}_{cot,out} rows and terminal_verifier_control.json, spec for spec (q3_* = Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 on :8001, q35_* = Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 on :8002; CoT+output and output-only; thinking on, thinking_budget 12288, max_tokens 16384), so this row joins their 4x4 degradation matrix. The other probe (probe_ood) is held out too but scored after the run from eval_rollouts.jsonl (experiments/eval_inkling_probes_on_runs.py), not live, so it is not listed here. Every other field equals terminal_verifier_q3_cot.json except stop_after_zero_behavior_steps, which is null here, explicitly: Vlad's judge rows (seeds 200-205, 208-211, commit c30c466) ran without the early stop, which only his later rows and the controls had (16). A batch states its own value per run (scripts/rl_batch.py rosters). Seeds: v2's exclusion covers RL seeds 0 to 10,000 (docs/inkling_probes_amendment_1.md); the batch driver passes seed and run_name. Needs root (read_only_verifier), the two vLLM judge servers and the probe server; no OPENROUTER_API_KEY. env_options as in every terminal row: verifier_mode='submit_corrupted', submission_ends='first', require_explanation=true, read_only_verifier=true, last_turn_submit_notice=true.
